name: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services

plan.title: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029

mission.text: To provide services that promote and improve agriculture, agribusiness, and forests; protect consumers and businesses; and conserve farmland and natural resources for the prosperity of all North Carolinians.

citation.document: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Increase acres of farmland protected with long-term conservation easements and agreements.

citation.document: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Increase and enhance production and marketing of North Carolina agricultural products.

citation.document: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Increase protection of the state's forests from wildfire.

citation.document: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Increase management and promotion of forest resources.

citation.document: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Protect public health through food safety, animal health and consumer protection, improving complaint response.

citation.document: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Create positive entertainment and educational experiences that promote NC agriculture.

citation.document: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029
